questions.question: Which of the following is named after Michael Faraday?
options: The farad, the SI unit of capacitance
The newton, the SI unit of force
The volt, the SI unit of electric potential
The ohm, the SI unit of electrical resistance
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that the SI unit of capacitance, the farad, is named after him.
Incorrect. The newton is named after Isaac Newton, not Faraday.
Incorrect. The volt is named after Alessandro Volta, not Faraday.
Incorrect. The ohm is named after Georg Ohm, not Faraday.
